description: Eczematous inflammation affecting the external ear or ear canal region.
causes: Eczematous skin inflammation; contact irritation or allergy may contribute

appearance.general: Dry, scaly, inflamed skin may affect the outer ear or entrance to the ear canal.

warning_signs: Significant ear pain, discharge, fever, or hearing change requires medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss headphones, hearing aids, hair products, earrings, or topical products that may contact the ear.
